findings.title: PF Deduction Inconsistent with Declared Basic
findings.explanation: PF employee share of Rs. 3,600 implies a basic salary of Rs. 30,000 at the statutory 12% rate, but the declared basic is Rs. 52,000.

findings.title: PF Deduction Does Not Match EPFO Record
findings.explanation: The payslip PF deduction (Rs. 3,600) does not match the employee share filed by Acme Technologies Pvt Ltd in EPFO for 2026-03 (Rs. 1,800). The employer files EPFO contributions independently.
